title: MCP adapter v1 tool contracts
$comment: Validate a named tool input/output by reference to its $defs entry. Domain, strict JSON decoding, and filesystem rules also apply. All thirty-one version 1 document and authoring tools are implemented, including cross-document copy/transfer between two open documents; typed detail covers the seven supported primitive kinds and the four supported MOP kinds within the similarity slice, while non-similarity transforms and relationships stay diagnostic.

Path.description: Additional canonical workspace containment and component rules in MCP_CONTRACT.md are mandatory.

Filename.description: A client-facing suggested leaf filename, never a server filesystem path.

XmlContent.description: Complete UTF-8 CamBam XML. The encoded byte length is also limited to 10 MiB.
